consent.copy: Recording became part of the demo since your last visit. It is how we see where the product gets confusing, and it is a condition of using the demo - continuing accepts it. Passwords are never recorded, and the demo only holds made-up data.
consent.title: Demo sessions are recorded

events.demo_adapters_catalog_viewed: Viewer loaded the adapters catalog page
events.demo_ai_suggest_attempted: Viewer clicked "Suggest with AI" - the locked write action - the primary AI-description intent-to-convert signal
events.demo_category_map_attempted: Viewer selected a category to map (not gated - the server may reject an invalid pairing, still a valid intent signal)
events.demo_category_mapping_opened: Viewer opened the category mapping page for a connection
events.demo_category_source_selected: Viewer changed the marketplace/source connection on the category mapping page
events.demo_command_palette_result_selected: Viewer selected a result in the command palette
events.demo_connection_create_attempted: Viewer clicked "Create connection" - the locked write action - the primary connection-creation intent-to-convert signal
events.demo_connection_platform_selected: Viewer picked a platform card on the new-connection page
events.demo_connection_sync_dialog_opened: Viewer opened the Trigger sync dialog for a connection
events.demo_connection_test_attempted: Viewer clicked "Test connection" - the locked write action - the primary connection-test intent-to-convert signal
events.demo_connection_wizard_step_advanced: Viewer advanced a step in a platform connection setup wizard
events.demo_connections_filtered: Viewer applied a filter on the connections list
events.demo_content_publish_attempted: Viewer clicked "Publish" on a content (description) draft
events.demo_fiscal_register_attempted: Viewer clicked "Register" on a fiscal receipt - the locked write action - the primary fiscalization intent-to-convert signal
events.demo_invoice_doctype_changed: Viewer changed the invoice document type before issuing
events.demo_invoice_issue_attempted: Viewer clicked "Issue invoice" - the locked write action - the primary invoicing intent-to-convert signal
events.demo_ksef_numbering_tab_switched: Viewer switched tabs on the invoice numbering page
events.demo_ksef_numbering_variable_inserted: Viewer inserted a numbering variable into the series template
events.demo_ksef_series_editor_opened: Viewer opened the invoice numbering series editor
events.demo_ksef_series_save_attempted: Viewer clicked "Save series" - the locked write action - the primary invoice-numbering intent-to-convert signal
events.demo_label_generate_attempted: Viewer clicked "Generate label" - the primary shipment-intent signal
events.demo_mapping_save_attempted: Viewer clicked "Save mappings" on a mapping panel (not gated - the server may reject the save)
events.demo_offer_create_attempted: Viewer clicked "Create offer(s)" - the locked write action - the primary offer-creation intent-to-convert signal
events.demo_offer_create_launched: Viewer launched the offer-creation flow for one or more products
events.demo_offer_marketplace_picked: Viewer picked a marketplace connection to create an offer on
events.demo_offer_wizard_review_reached: Viewer reached the review step of the offer-creation wizard
events.demo_offer_wizard_step_advanced: Viewer advanced a step in the offer-creation wizard
events.demo_opensource_link_clicked: Viewer clicked the "View on GitHub" link in the app shell
events.demo_order_opened: Viewer opened an order detail page
events.demo_orders_filtered: Viewer applied a filter on the orders list
events.demo_product_row_expanded: Viewer expanded a product row for more detail (mobile card view)
events.demo_viewer_locked_action_clicked: Viewer clicked a locked (read-only) write action - the primary intent-to-convert signal for a read-only demo session

recording.browser: Your browser, screen size, and rough location from your IP
recording.nothingReal: Nothing real. Every store, order, and invoice in the demo is made up.
recording.pages: Pages you open and buttons you click

trackingFootnote: This visit is being logged for analytics. No personal profile is created from this.
